title_en: SALES START AT ADRIA RESIDENCE IN QERRET! POSSIBILITY OF PAYMENT IN CASH!
description_en: Eon129369 Studio for sale in the newest elite residence in Qerret! The construction has just started and has a deadline of 2 years. The apartment has a net area of ​​37.1 m2 and a total area of ​​42.9 m2. Payment divided into 6 installments: • 30% with the writing of the contract. •20% after 6 months. • 20% after another 6 months. • 20% after another 6 months. • 5% upon delivery of the property. • 5% upon delivery of the certificate. Adria Residence is where the sea meets comfort and elegance. Located in one of the greenest and quietest areas of Qerret, just 200 meters from the coast, with direct access to the beach through the street in front, the residence offers about 330 modern apartments and about 200 dedicated parking spaces, a community pool, green spaces and contemporary architecture. With a construction standard from the highest in the market where we mention some details such as: • Concrete according to modern anti-seismic standards, with certified concrete C30/37 and structural steel B500B. • Ventilated facade, a modern system that provides excellent thermal and acoustic insulation, moisture protection, longevity and an elegant appearance. • Floor heating - InfraRed Foil System Uniform heating with high efficiency, immediate comfort and minimal maintenance (optional). • Acoustic insulation in walls and floors The apartments are equipped with double brick walls with three layers (brick / stone wool / brick) that provide excellent sound insulation and an acoustic substrate that significantly reduces the noise of steps and movements between floors. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us!
